name: Exide Industries Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest lead-acid battery maker: automotive (OEM and replacement), industrial (telecom, UPS, solar, railways, submarine) and the lithium-ion cell venture Exide Energy Solutions (6 GWh Phase-I commissioned 2026-09-23). Near debt-free. Sep-26 quarter: sales Rs 5,026 cr (+20% y/y), OPM 12%, net profit Rs 386 cr (+75% y/y); stock jumped ~7% on 2026-11-04. The stock is -22% over three months and -9% over one month before results, P/E 23, market cap Rs 31,437 cr. Lead (~38% of revenue, estimate) is the swing input.

supply_chain.note: Li-ion cell JV/subsidiary; Rs 100 cr infusion on 2026-09-30

supply_chain.counterparty: Maruti, Hero, Bajaj, TVS, Tata Motors

supply_chain.note: Domestic lead supply plus recycled and imported lead

company_events.event: Q2 FY27 results delivered: net profit +75%, revenue +20%
Exide Energy Phase-I ramp-up and customer qualifications
Further capital infusion into Exide Energy or customer MoUs

current_state.latest_quarter: Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026): sales Rs 5,026 cr (+20% y/y), EBITDA Rs 606 cr (OPM 12%), net profit Rs 386 cr (+75% y/y)
current_state.trend: Margins recovering from 9% in Sep-25 to 12%; revenue acceleration (+13% TTM); FII holding up from 10.3% to 13.2% in two quarters
current_state.valuation: P/E 22.9, P/B 2.1 (370 vs BV 174), EV/EBITDA ~13x TTM (computed); ROE 7.5%
recent_developments: 2026-09-30: stock jumps up to 10% on PM-DHARA scheme; Rs 100 cr infused in EV arm

key_risks: Lead price spikes and lagged pass-through
Li-ion ramp execution, cell yield and customer wins
Weak OEM auto demand after rate hike
upside_triggers: Li-ion customer wins and PLI payouts

exposures.mechanism: Lead alloy ~38% of revenue (model knowledge). +10% zinc/lead basket (lead moves ~0.7x) => +2.7% of revenue; OEM contracts are lead-linked with 1-3 month lag, replacement prices reset once or twice a year; ~25% unrecovered => 0.7% of revenue => EBITDA -5.6% at 12% OPM; x0.95 x persistence 0.25 => -1.3 to -1.5. Lead is not in the pack's sensitivity table.

evidence.note: Sep-26 qtr OPM 12% (vs 9% a year ago)
Lead share of cost is an estimate

exposures.mechanism: OEM (2W/PV/CV) ~30% and replacement ~40% of revenue (replacement follows parc and with lag); +10% auto volumes => OEM +10% and replacement +3% => revenue +4%; incremental margin 30% vs 12% OPM => EBITDA +10%; x0.95 x0.5 => ~+4.5, trimmed to +4.

Energy-storage demand (BESS, EV cells, telecom, UPS) is the growth option: Exide Energy Solutions commissioned Phase-I of its 6 GWh Li-ion cell plant in Bengaluru (2026-09-23), Rs 100 cr equity infused (2026-09-30), and Exide jumped up to 10% after the PM-DHARA scheme announcement (2026-09-30, details unverified). +1 => 2% value uplift on ramp visibility => +3.

ACC PLI-linked incentives for Exide Energy's cell plant (milestone penalties/credits); +1 expansion/disbursement => cell economics improve; incentive stream ~Rs 100-150 cr/yr on Rs 31,400 cr cap (model estimate) => +4 with high uncertainty.

Net of two effects: higher cell costs squeeze Exide Energy's start-up margins (-1.5 over ramp) but make Li-ion a weaker substitute for lead-acid in 2W/UPS, helping legacy lead-acid (+1.0). Wide range reflects the sign ambiguity.
Polypropylene containers and separators ~6% of costs, crude-linked; +10% Brent => EBITDA -2% x0.95 x0.3 => -0.6. Empirical -0.88 (t=-1.5) agrees on sign.

Lead (partly imported/LME-linked), cell components and Li-ion equipment are USD costs vs exports ~5% of revenue; +3% => costs +0.9% of revenue gross, ~half passed through => EBITDA -3% x0.95 x0.3 => -0.8. Empirical +2.30 (t=1.4) is positive but insignificant; hence a wide range.
Vehicle demand and OEM channel financing; +25bp => auto-volume drag -0.5% => EBITDA -1.5% x0.95 x0.4 => -0.6. Exide has near-zero debt so direct interest effect is negligible.

Empirical -2.95 (t=-2.9) is statistically strong but has no fundamental channel for batteries (cotton is a rural income/inflation proxy); treated as spurious/proxy for rural demand and kept at 0 with a wide range pending review.
